summary: Verified REACT_APP_API_BASE override works. All frontend API traffic routes to https://api.binaryfundglobal.com and NOT to the emergent placeholder host. Confirmed via live network trace on landing page and login page (including a real POST /api/auth/login that returned 401 from the VPS).

verifications.env_file_ok: /app/frontend/.env contains REACT_APP_API_BASE=https://api.binaryfundglobal.com (line 2) and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL kept as emergent placeholder (line 1, unused).
verifications.apiBase_priority_ok: /app/frontend/src/lib/apiBase.js exports API_BASE = REACT_APP_API_BASE || REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — VPS wins.
verifications.no_hardcoded_urls: grep of /app/frontend/src shows only apiBase.js references either env var; no hardcoded emergentagent or binaryfundglobal URLs elsewhere.
verifications.bundle_baked_in: Compiled bundle.js served by frontend triggers XHRs to api.binaryfundglobal.com at runtime, confirming REACT_APP_API_BASE was baked into the build. Direct HTTP fetch of bundle from python was 403 (Cloudflare bot block) — runtime evidence is authoritative.

critical_code_review_comments: Consider removing the stale REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL line from /app/frontend/.env to avoid future confusion — apiBase.js already ignores it, but the placeholder value is misleading.
Also add REACT_APP_API_BASE to /app/frontend/.env.example (if it exists) so future clones don't miss it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend uses REACT_APP_API_BASE from /app/frontend/.env for all API calls via /app/frontend/src/lib/apiBase.js. VPS backend at api.binaryfundglobal.com is external — do not try to control or restart it. CORS is properly configured on the VPS (POST /api/auth/login returned 401 with body, not blocked). If REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL gets platform-reset again, the app is unaffected.
